Nina R: Heads-up — CloudMart flagged a marketplace allocation bug: they accidentally applied a 2x multiplier to reserved capacity for private tenants during an SI onboarding. We're seeing duplicate reservations for the same customer commits.
Ola M: ugh. any reservation ids?
Nina R: From console: rm_99011 and rm_99012 for commit CM-1129. Both show 'allocated' against the same physical inventory pool.
CloudMart: Apologies — we pushed a mapping change for SI mappings and a transform duplicated the reservation rows. We have a rollback ready. If you want immediate fix we can mark rm_99012 as "staged-cancel" on our side and push corrected allocation.
Ben C: Important: if we cancel rm_99012 abruptly, some enterprise customers will see an inventory reflow and could hit provisioning failures. Need a controlled rollback.
Marta S: Sales just opened a ticket; worried about the joint announcement next week. If customers lose units they'll ask for credits.
Ola M: quick diagnostic query:
```
# allocation check
curl -s "https://console.redwood/api/allocs?commit=CM-1129" | jq '.[] | {reservation: .id, state: .state, pool: .pool, qty: .qty}'
```
Nina R: ran — output: rm_99011 qty 16, rm_99012 qty 16, pool private-eu-1. Total shows 32 allocated but physical pool has 16.
liaison-bot: Created partner-ticket #CM-AL-4729 and assigned to CloudMart-Supply.
CloudMart: Plan A: we'll execute a coordinated cancel+reassign window at 2025-08-12 02:00 UTC. We'll push a reconciliation manifest and update marketplace ledger. Plan B (faster): we'll tag rm_99012 -> "shadow" so Redwood can ignore it during provisioning and we keep audit trail. Which do you prefer?
Ben C: Prefer Plan B — shadow tag avoids abrupt cancel and keeps audit trail for finance. We need idempotent reconcile though.
Ola M: agree. But add a guard: provisioning service should check for shadow tag and skip. Need a tiny code change + one-line feature flag. Who owns?
Nina R: Ops owns the flag, Ben can author the reconcile job to collapse shadow reservations.
Ben C: I'll draft the reconcile: collapse shadow -> move qty to rm_99011 -> record event. ETA 3h to staging dry-run.
Marta S: I'll hold comms with Sales and Legal, mention partner is offering to waive marketplace fees for affected units.
CloudMart: We'll implement shadow tagging now and delay manifest consolidation until after your dry-run. We'll send ASN update after reconcile.
liaison-bot: Shadow tag applied to rm_99012 by CloudMart (action id 8812).
Ola M: Ops note: we must ensure SLA calc uses physical pool not ledger allocated. I'll open infra ticket to patch SLA calc window.
Nina R: summary: CloudMart -> shadow rm_99012; Ben -> reconcile job; Ops -> feature flag + SLA calc check; Marta -> customer comms. Keep this thread for final ASN.
Ben C: starting work. Will post dry-run logs here.
Nina R: thanks — keep it tight, don't want announcement impacted.
